text: Near the middle of the pitch on the right side, Joon Fairweather steps up to the penalty spot around 26 metres from Ironvale Athletic’s goal at the far end. After a foul by Aiden Morales on Redmond Rovers, Fairweather takes a quick, confident shot with his foot. The ball hits the back of the goal, leveling the score at 2-2 in the 81st minute. This goal caps a period of intense pressure from Redmond Rovers, who have been pressing high and swiftly circulating the ball. [#1474] [#1475]
